service.name: Musician for a proposal or a surprise song
service.serviceType: A musician or duo for a marriage proposal, a surprise song at a birthday or anniversary dinner, or a short set at a small private moment
service.description: A guitarist, a singer or a duo playing one song or a short set at a marriage proposal, a surprise at a birthday or anniversary dinner, or a small private moment, in Denver, the Front Range and the Colorado mountain towns, booked at a minimum and planned to the minute with the person arranging it.

faqs.q: Can I hire a musician for just one song?
faqs.a: Yes. A proposal, a surprise at a birthday dinner, an anniversary song: one song is a real booking here, planned as carefully as a four-hour evening. There's a booking minimum, because the musician's whole evening goes to being in the right place at the right minute, and it's quoted for the date. Signet Artists books them across Denver and the Colorado mountains.

faqs.q: Do restaurants and public places allow it?
faqs.a: Most restaurants say yes when asked in advance, and we ask, so the manager knows a musician is coming and where the small case goes. A park, a trailhead or a rooftop sometimes needs a permit and sometimes a battery-powered system, and we plan that with you. We never surprise the venue.

Quiet enough to pass for the restaurant's usual background music until the song starts, so nobody at your table suspects anything. Outdoors, a guitarist plays with a small battery-powered system or none at all, depending on the wind and the spot.

faqs.q: Can the musician learn our song?
faqs.a: Yes. The song is learned for the day if it isn't already in the book, and one learned song comes with every booking. Tell us whether it should be played on the guitar or sung.
